generator.conditioning: original per-frame MIDI pitch activity/onsets and drum pulse, streamed with retained model state
generator.notes_adherence: requires measured and listening verification; conditioning alone is not proof

performance_source.midi_clock_adherence: source pulse drifted despite conditioning; measured pulse retimed to160, note adherence not claimed

component_type: complementary spectral/rhythmic derivatives of one generated performance; not isolated instrument stems
menu_delivery: 16-bit native PCM full-frame loop, no lossy decoder

loop_repair.change: 32ms boundary damping only on rhythmic component; unchanged exact frame count and other performances
